coupon.form.title: New coupon
coupon.form.intro: The coupon goes live for claiming as soon as you create it, and buyers can claim it from your shop page. Enter amounts in yuan; for a discount coupon enter 0.9 for 10% off, and you must set a maximum discount.
coupon.form.name.label: Coupon name
coupon.form.type.label: Coupon type
coupon.form.threshold.label: Minimum spend (¥)
coupon.form.rate.label: Discount rate (0.90 = 10% off)
coupon.form.discount.label: Amount off (¥)
coupon.form.maxDiscount.label: Maximum discount (¥)
coupon.form.maxDiscount.placeholder: So big orders don't cost you too much, e.g. 50
coupon.form.maxDiscount.hint: Required: a discount coupon with no cap loses money on large orders
coupon.form.total.label: Total quantity
coupon.form.windowFrom.label: Claiming starts
coupon.form.windowFrom.hint: Buyers can claim from this moment
coupon.form.windowTo.label: Claiming ends
coupon.form.windowTo.hint: Buyers can claim until this moment
coupon.form.validDays.label: Valid days after claiming (optional)
coupon.form.validDays.hint: Leave blank to have the coupon follow the claiming window; otherwise it runs from the moment it's claimed (1–365)
coupon.form.err.nameMax: Coupon name must be at most {max} characters
coupon.form.err.totalInt: Total quantity must be a whole number of at least 1
coupon.form.err.totalMax: Total quantity may be at most {max}
coupon.form.err.rateRange: Discount rate must be between 0.01 and 0.99 (0.90 = 10% off)
coupon.form.err.maxDiscountRequired: Discount coupons require a maximum discount
coupon.form.err.discountPositive: Discount amount must be greater than 0
coupon.form.err.discountOverThreshold: The discount cannot exceed the threshold amount; check for swapped values

coupon.form.err.windowOrder: The end time must be later than the start time
coupon.toast.created: Coupon created — buyers can claim it now
coupon.page.intro: Creating a coupon only defines the distribution rules; coupons are actually issued when buyers claim them. "Issued" is how many were claimed, "redeemed" is how many were actually used in orders.
coupon.page.noEditNotice: Coupon templates can't be edited: coupons already claimed keep the snapshot from when they were claimed, so changing the template only affects later claims. To adjust the rules, disable the old coupon and create a new one.
coupon.page.empty.title: No coupons yet
coupon.page.empty.description: Set the discount rules and total quantity, and buyers can claim them from your shop page
coupon.list.header.name: Coupon name
coupon.list.confirm.stop.title: Disable coupon
coupon.list.confirm.stop.desc: Disable “{name}”? Buyers won't be able to claim it afterward, but coupons already claimed stay valid. There's no way to re-enable it here — to keep distributing, create a new one.
